name: zn-gate
description: Local security layer for Claude Code: keeps secret values out of what Claude sends to the model, adds a secrets MCP server that uses credentials without revealing them, and checks untrusted text for prompt injection with local rules.

api_key.title: zn API key (optional)
api_key.description: A Pro or Team API key from usezn.com/dashboard. With a key, the analyze_prompt tool also asks the zn cloud classifier, and the text it checks (secrets redacted first) is sent to api.usezn.com. Leave it empty to keep everything on this machine.
